_about: synthetic patient phrasings, AI-assisted, not clinical wording; English translations are AI-assisted. Our own words, written for the Site Signal simulation (docs/11-site-signal-sap.md §11.2 step 9): one bank per primary term x grade band x language. Never PRO-CTCAE item text, never spoken by the agent, never used for grading (grades come only from rules.py). Every quote drawn from this bank is labeled source synthetic and data_origin SIMULATED; a Spanish quote carries its English translation with translation_is_ai true, so the UI shows an AiLabel. No names, no medical advice.

en.quote: My stomach's been off and I'm going to the bathroom several more times a day than I usually do.
It's been runny and I keep having to go, a good handful of extra trips every day.
I can still get through my day, but I'm in the bathroom way more often than normal.
Since the weekend my bowels have been acting up and I'm going a lot more than my usual.
It's not all day long, but I'm going noticeably more each day and it comes on fast.

es.quote: Tengo el estómago revuelto y voy al baño varias veces más al día de lo normal.
es.translation_en: My stomach is upset and I go to the bathroom several more times a day than usual.

es.quote: Hago del baño muy aguado y tengo que ir bastante más seguido que antes.
es.translation_en: My stools are very watery and I have to go quite a bit more often than before.

es.quote: Puedo hacer mis cosas, pero paso mucho más tiempo en el baño que de costumbre.
es.translation_en: I can do my things, but I spend a lot more time in the bathroom than usual.

es.quote: Desde el fin de semana estoy yendo al baño mucho más de lo que acostumbro.
es.translation_en: Since the weekend I have been going to the bathroom much more than I usually do.

en.quote: It's nonstop. I've lost count of how many times I've gone today.
I can barely leave the bathroom, it's been going all day and all night.
I couldn't go to my grandson's game because I can't be away from a toilet.
It's way past anything normal for me, I'm going over and over, about every hour.

es.quote: No para. Ya perdí la cuenta de cuántas veces he ido hoy.
es.translation_en: It doesn't stop. I have already lost count of how many times I have gone today.

es.quote: Casi no puedo salir del baño, ha sido todo el día y toda la noche.
es.translation_en: I can hardly leave the bathroom; it has been all day and all night.

es.quote: No pude ir a misa porque no me puedo alejar del baño.
es.translation_en: I couldn't go to Mass because I can't get away from the bathroom.

es.quote: Voy y voy, más o menos cada hora, nunca me había pasado así.
es.translation_en: I go and go, about every hour; it has never happened to me like this.

en.quote: I've been burning up, the thermometer read about 103.
Chills since yesterday, and it got up to around 39 and a half.
I was shivering under two blankets and my temperature was high, around 103.
Last night my temperature was really high and I felt awful, sweating and then freezing.

es.quote: Anoche tuve escalofríos y el termómetro marcó más de 39.
es.translation_en: Last night I had chills and the thermometer showed over 39.

es.quote: Tengo calentura desde ayer, llegó a 39 y medio.
es.translation_en: I have had a fever since yesterday; it reached 39 and a half.

es.quote: Estaba temblando con dos cobijas encima y la fiebre en casi 40.
es.translation_en: I was shaking under two blankets with the fever at almost 40.

es.quote: Me sentí muy mal, sudaba y luego me daba frío, la temperatura bien alta.
es.translation_en: I felt very sick, sweating and then getting cold, the temperature very high.

en.quote: The thermometer went over 104 and I was really scared.
My temperature hit 40 and a half, I've never had one that high.
It went above 104 last night and it just wouldn't come down.
I was soaked and shaking and the reading was over 104.

es.quote: El termómetro pasó de 40 y me asusté mucho.
es.translation_en: The thermometer went past 40 and I got very scared.

es.quote: La fiebre llegó a 40 y medio, nunca la había tenido tan alta.
es.translation_en: The fever reached 40 and a half; I had never had it that high.

es.quote: Anoche subió a más de 40 y no bajaba.
es.translation_en: Last night it went up to over 40 and would not come down.

es.quote: Estaba empapado y temblando, y marcaba más de 40.
es.translation_en: I was soaked and shaking, and it read over 40.

en.quote: I get winded just walking to the mailbox and have to stop to catch my breath.
Carrying the laundry up the stairs leaves me huffing and puffing now.
Making the bed wears me out, I'm breathing hard afterwards.
I used to walk the dog around the block, now I have to rest halfway.

es.quote: Me falta el aire nada más con caminar al buzón y tengo que pararme.
es.translation_en: I run out of air just walking to the mailbox and I have to stop.

es.quote: Subir la ropa por las escaleras me deja jadeando.
es.translation_en: Carrying the laundry up the stairs leaves me panting.

es.quote: Tender la cama me cansa y quedo respirando fuerte.
es.translation_en: Making the bed tires me out and I am left breathing hard.

es.quote: Antes daba la vuelta a la cuadra con el perro, ahora tengo que descansar a medio camino.
es.translation_en: I used to walk around the block with the dog; now I have to rest halfway.

en.quote: Even sitting in my chair I feel like I can't get enough air.
I get out of breath just talking to you right now.
Lying down is hard, I have to prop myself up on pillows to breathe.
I'm breathless even when I'm not doing anything at all.

es.quote: Aun sentada en mi sillón siento que no me alcanza el aire.
es.translation_en: Even sitting in my armchair I feel I can't get enough air.

es.quote: Me falta el aire nada más de estar hablando con usted.
es.translation_en: I run out of air just from talking with you.

es.quote: Acostado me cuesta respirar, tengo que ponerme almohadas para poder respirar.
es.translation_en: Lying down it is hard to breathe; I have to put pillows behind me to be able to breathe.

es.quote: Me falta el aire aunque esté quieto, sin hacer nada.
es.translation_en: I am short of air even when I am still, doing nothing.
